create_cocoeval_instance: create a COCOeval instance with ground truth and detection COCO objects for segmentation evaluation
run_cocoeval_evaluate: run per-image evaluation on given images and store matching results in evalImgs
accumulate_cocoeval_results: accumulate per-image evaluation results into precision and recall arrays for all parameter combinations
summarize_cocoeval_stats: summarize accumulated evaluation results into 12 detection or 10 keypoints summary metrics
build_cocoeval_params: build COCOeval Params object with configurable IoU thresholds, recall thresholds, area ranges, and max detections
